title: New Unpatched Windows 0-Day FastUnlock Lets Someone Holding a Locked PC Run Programs on It
summary:
A newly disclosed unpatched zero-day technique called FastUnlock lets someone with physical access to a locked Windows computer start programs without signing in. Whoever uses it gets only a limited account, not administrator control of the machine.

The method was posted yesterday by a researcher who uses the handles MSNightmare and Nightmare Eclipse, and the endpoint-security firm ThreatLocker.

title: phpAfterShell Explained: How Hackers Could Turn a PHP Session Flaw Into Code Execution
summary:
PHP's default file-based session storage can be made to return objects an attacker chose, by cutting off a session write at the right moment. When combined with a second weakness, such as a suitable gadget chain in the app, those objects can allow the attacker to run code on the server.

Today's PHP releases fix the flaw, called phpAfterShell.

The flaw is tracked as CVE-2026-126714 and rated.

title: Critical VMware vCenter Zero-Day Flaw Lets Network Attackers Bypass Authentication
summary:
A critical flaw in VMware vCenter lets an attacker with network access bypass authentication and gain unauthorized access to the system, Broadcom, which owns VMware, said in an advisory published today.

title: Drupal Patches Critical Installer Flaw That Could Give Unauthenticated Attackers Control of Sites
summary:
Under specific conditions, a critical vulnerability in Drupal core can allow an attacker without login credentials to use the built-in installer to attempt to reinstall a site.

title: Hackers Breach N-able Cloud Server, Disrupting Email Security Management Across 3 Regions
summary:

title: Ruby Releases Fixes for 7 Regex and String Flaws, Warns 5 Have Proof-of-Concept RCE
summary:
Ruby contains seven memory-safety flaws in its regular expression engine and its string case-conversion code. For five of them, its maintainers say, proof-of-concept exploits, or PoCs, have shown that crafted input can run code on the machine.

"We are aware of PoCs that prove some of them can be used to trigger remote code execution," the maintainers said.

The project released fixed versions.
